title: Apollo Lunar Mission
description:
Ever wondered, how is it walk on the Moon’s surface? It is your time now to complete a Lunar mission in Virtual Reality. You can roam the Moon surface or ride the Lunar Rover in free mode. You can also complete a scientific mission on the Moon’s surface.



*Land the Lunar Module on the surface of the Moon

 

*Discover the Apollo Lunar Surface Experiments Package scientific instruments placed by the astronauts at the landing site



*Place each scientific instrument at the designated area



*Learn the facts about the scientific instruments and experiments 



* Walk roam freely on the Moon surface
description_short: Apollo Lunar Misson VR Simulator is a first-person experience on the surface of the Moon, as a member of the Apollo mission crew. Have fun while completing the tasks and exploring the Moon surface. Drive the Lunar Rover first hand.
